nodes.speaker: NPC 1
nodes.npcText: Hiya! Can I help you sir?

choices.text: Is this your ship down by the water?

nodes.speaker: NPC 1
nodes.npcText: Yes, we just crashed! Care to help? You could get this package to my fellow shipmate over yonder.

addObjective.description: Deliver the package to NPC 1's shipmate.

nodes.speaker: NPC 1
nodes.npcText: You're too kind young sir! Head north east toward one of the pillar mountains.
